title: The Pearl Harbor attack and the U.S. declaration of war
summary: The State Department dates the attack to 7 December 1941. The National Archives holds Roosevelt's 8 December address.
body: The U.S. Department of State's historical milestone says Japanese planes bombed the U.S. fleet at Pearl Harbor on 7 December 1941 and that the United States declared war on Japan the following day. The National Archives holds Franklin D. Roosevelt's 8 December 1941 address to Congress leading to that declaration. This is the U.S. documentary record of those two days. It is not a full history of the war in China since 1937, which the same State Department page says was already underway.
